name: thelia/cms-module
description: All-in-one CMS for Thelia 3: page tree, pages written from a brief through the AI layer of Thelia, menus, forms and media.

suggest.thelia/seone-module: Publishes the SEO metadata, canonical and hreflang tags of CMS pages.
suggest.thelia/rewrite-url-module: Back-office management of redirections and a log of 404s.
suggest.thelia/tnt-search-module: Indexes CMS pages for the TntSearch front-office search.
suggest.thelia/google-tag-manager-module: Sends CMS page views to the data layer.
suggest.thelia/tiptap-module: Rich-text editing of the html props of a section on the content screen (a plain textarea without it).
